value_provenance.baseline: existing basin IDs, connections, bounds and portal anchors from pinned Kari data
value_provenance.proposed: all target shapes, relief, traversal endpoints, minimap positions, dimensions for new fields and art programs are Kari initial proposals
value_provenance.not_measured: No original MHP2G map coordinates, elevations, collision dimensions or internal timing were measured.

coordinates.shape_uv: Unclosed polygon vertices [u,v] in [0,1]. Concept only; author/compiler connects portal anchors and resolves walls, support surfaces and navigation. Not an immediately valid runtime polygon.
coordinates.height_band_m: Proposed local terrain range for each area, not a continuous physical coordinate across portals.
coordinates.minimap: Authored geographic composition independent of runtime 240m grid; labels and polygon overlap require visual adjustment.

terrain_query_contract.rule: Select reachable same or adjacent support surface. Climb/flight/drop owns position until an explicit landing/exit selects support; no ordinary ground snap during traversal.

offscreen_state_contract: Release render resources per area; preserve and deterministically progress monster location/movement/sleep/recovery, resource depletion and mark expiry.
global_acceptance: All hunter paths return to camp.
All large-only route edges join large-capable areas and respect body clearance.
No climb/drop enters a solid wall or wrong support layer.
No source game asset is needed for runtime conversion.
Each field is playable with matching quests/material paths before implementation completion.

topology_templates.description: 現行盆地の11エリアと14接続を初期保持。主戦場回遊と人だけの採集枝道。
乾いた島の大小二つの回遊路。浅瀬と根の枝道から合流。
海岸側の開けた経路と海食洞の戻り道。広い接続床から洞へ入る。
広い坑口と岩盆を通る大型経路。採掘坑が人だけの短絡を作る。
尾根を登る主路と中腹の帰還回路。局所の登攀・降下で高さを読む。
大樹の周りの回遊と根の下を抜ける人用経路。光と幹で方角を示す。
天井の抜けた洞床が輪になり、低い枝洞が人用経路になる。
広い河床の分流・合流。側面経路で大型の進路を見ながら合流する。

geometry_defaults.shape: Each area references shape_templates. Portal anchors must be connected and validated during authoring.

field_defaults.resource_and_rank_gate: 対応する種・依頼・素材の恒久IDを既存表から解決。狩場未完成の素材を盆地へ代替配置しない。
field_defaults.hazard_policy: 環境負担は別データで宣言。温い晶脈や濡れた床の見た目だけから持続ダメージを付けない。

connection_validation_contract.hunter: Every topology connection must be traversed in both directions, with valid spawn, return and support surface.
connection_validation_contract.large: Every large=true connection must be tested in both directions for every applicable body-clearance class, including braking/turning and local terrain links.
connection_validation_contract.route_limit: The listed inspection route visits all large-capable areas; it is not proof of coverage of all graph edges. Compare tested edge pairs against connections and complete missing pairs separately.
